title: Birth of a Rescue Unit - 1000 Lives Saved
description: The 129th Rescue Wing has saved over 1,000 lives. May 18, 2013 marked the milestone for the 1000th save. The wing's alumni recall memories from the unit's first rescue, through present day. Pararescuemen and current members share their experience of the 1000th save. (U.S. California Air National Guard video by Airman 1st Class Julia Bates/Released)
